name: Syntec Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Syntec Technology Co., Ltd., founded in 1995 and headquartered in Hsinchu City, Taiwan, specializes in industrial automation. The company is actively involved in the research, development, production, sales, and ongoing support of electronic automation controllers for industrial applications. Its operations span Taiwan, the broader Asian market, and international territories. Beyond its core controller business, Syntec also delivers design and technical maintenance solutions for factory machinery automation systems. Its comprehensive product lineup features controllers, motors, encoders, and a range of servo products tailored for diverse sectors such as metalworking, woodworking, and laser processing. Furthermore, Syntec supplies machine tools, various electronic control devices, laser equipment, and electrical machinery.
